author_scope: WACV constructive real-data follow-through; existing manuscript remains fallback. No external submission.
authorization: User already requested continued experiments and direct Claude debate. Both GPUs explicitly allowed in the active Claude tmux session; leave desktop memory headroom.
prospective_limit: Registered after existing MICrONS/control outcomes; future R outcomes and S real-label scores not examined at registration. Existing E1 tasks are already-examined, so this is exploratory generality, not fresh benchmark validation.
go_rule: Implementation and input/protocol hashes recorded after structural smoke. No R AllTest/far run or S real-label probe until that technical check. This is reproducibility review within existing user authorization, not a request for additional user permission.
question: Does the matched navigation-readout pattern extend to another released neural-prediction architecture with ten mouse readouts?

model.independence: Ten readouts share one learned core. Training animal/cohort overlap with the Wang foundation model is not verified; do not claim ten additional independent animals.
model.responses: predicted single-cell responses, not recorded responses to rendered mazes

views.poses: Exact existing E1 sampler rng0 and move/goal labels/split, asserted against cached arrays
views.downsample: nonoverlapping4x4 area pooling; exact same low-resolution arrays go to all primary floors
views.gamma: retain existing renderer pixel convention; do not claim measured retinal luminance matching
views.normalization: author per-mouse video training mean/std with same epsilon as released transform
views.behavior_and_pupil: author training means, no task-derived behavior inputs

clip.feature: mean predicted neuronal response over last10 frames

views.same_information: pixels36 directly from36x64; V1 from only those same arrays upsampled bilinearly to144x256 to preserve angular kernel convention
views.original_high_resolution_floors: context only, separately labeled; never primary ViV1T comparison

alone_per_mouse: same readout with author-initialized core seed0

probe.type: two-layer nonlinear MLP, not linear decoder
probe.pca: fit only training poses; alone256; fusion components separately256+128; capacity384
probe.splits: fixed existing source-family-disjoint E1 split; no changing after outcomes

statistics.cluster: 10 original held-out source maze families, mouse_twin_family.source_family, not27 descendant tasks
statistics.accuracy: per-test-pose correctness averaged over three probe seeds; bootstrap original families retaining their pose rows
statistics.primary: Descriptive count of A-J whose paired95percent interval is entirely positive for each prespecified floor; report all mouse/task-label differences alongside counts. No selection of readouts.
statistics.secondary: readout-averaged correctness before family bootstrap, conditional on shared core
statistics.multiplicity: Full contrast matrix retained; descriptive exploratory intervals without a new-animal significance interpretation

allowed_before_real_scores: probe/bootstrap mechanics on permuted labels only
smoke.forbidden: real held-out label scoring even a5percent pilot before this registration

interpretation.positive: Conditional generality or added information beyond the exact matched floor, on already-examined E1 tasks. Probe success does not establish useful closed-loop control.
interpretation.negative: Limited readout under fixed clip/probe, not a claim that all learned neural representations are unusable.
interpretation.novelty_limit: Lima already probed latent representations and explicitly anticipated across-family/dataset comparisons. This generality check is supporting evidence, not a first-use headline.

outputs_required: all learned and random feature arrays
PCA/probe source hashes, seeds and settings
all contrast inputs/results and all10 readouts
